mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce varenicline exposure and efficacy, while varenicline may lower eslicarbazepine levels through uncertain mechanisms; additive CNS effects are also possible.
action: Monitor varenicline efficacy for smoking cessation and consider dose adjustment or alternative anticonvulsant if efficacy is compromised; monitor eslicarbazepine levels and clinical seizure control.
